LESSON: PRANAYAM

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga
Topic 5.1: Pranayam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pranayam. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: hown videos/ 1. What are asanas?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practice exercises for physical development
2. appreciate pranayam as a way of coping with emotions 5.2 Asanas (Body Postures) ( 6 lessons) improve physical health
3. develop self-control ( to sit quietly for few minutes) to promote good discipline - Parvat aasan (Mountain pose) practice simple asanas in appropriate attire in groups or pairs.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. practice exercises for physical development
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice exercises for physical development. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate pranayam as a way of coping with emotions 5.2 Asanas (Body Postures) ( 6 lessons) improve physical health
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate pranayam as a way of coping with emotions 5.2 Asanas (Body Postures) ( 6 lessons) improve physical health. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. develop self-control ( to sit quietly for few minutes) to promote good discipline - Parvat aasan (Mountain pose) practice simple asanas in appropriate attire in groups or pairs.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop self-control ( to sit quietly for few minutes) to promote good discipline - Parvat aasan (Mountain pose) practice simple asanas in appropriate attire in groups or pairs. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pranayam.
2. Explain Pranayam to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pranayam.
4. Show that you can: practice exercises for physical development
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pranayam. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: hown videos/ 1. What are asanas?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. practice exercises for physical development
2. appreciate pranayam as a way of coping with emotions 5.2 Asanas (Body Postures) ( 6 lessons) improve physical health
3. develop self-control ( to sit quietly for few minutes) to promote good discipline - Parvat aasan (Mountain pose) practice simple asanas in appropriate attire in groups or pairs.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
